forbidden.title: You don’t manage any automation in this base
forbidden.description: Creating, editing, turning on or off an automation needs base admin rights, or manage rights on the table that triggers it.

create.title: Create automation

unavailable.schedule: Only base admins can create scheduled automations.
unavailable.webhook: Only base admins can create automations started by a webhook.

create.note: Next you set up its trigger and steps. It is created, off, when you first save it.

enable.title: Turn on automation?
enable.warning: Once on, it will run with your permissions instead of {{user}}’s.
enable.detail: Every step that reads, writes or sends uses your current permissions in base {{base}}.

takeOver.title: Take over “{{name}}”?

takeOver.runsAs: It runs with the permissions of {{user}}.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The automation and its run history will be deleted. Waiting runs are cancelled. This cannot be undone.

toast.conflict: “{{name}}” was changed elsewhere meanwhile. The list is up to date now; try again.
toast.gone: “{{name}}” no longer exists or you can no longer manage it.

type.record.date_reached: When a date in a record is reached
type.webhook.received: When a webhook request is received

duplicate.done: «{{name}}» created. The copy is off and will run with your permissions.

failure.permissions: The copy would run with your permissions, and this automation uses tables, fields or senders you cannot use. Nothing was created.
failure.invalid: This automation no longer saves as it is, so no copy was made. Fix it first, then duplicate it.
failure.forbidden: You no longer manage this automation.

duplicate.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes first: the copy is made from the saved version.
